1.web: Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.
1.asv: Fret not thyself because of evil-doers, Neither be thou envious against them that work unrighteousness.

2.web: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.
2.asv: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, And wither as the green herb.

3.web: Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.
3.asv: Trust in Jehovah, and do good; Dwell in the land, and feed onhisfaithfulness.

4.web: Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
4.asv: Delight thyself also in Jehovah; And he will give thee the desires of thy heart.

5.web: Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this:
5.asv: Commit thy way unto Jehovah; Trust also in him, and he will bring it to pass.

6.web: he will make your righteousness go out as the light, and your justice as the noon day sun.
6.asv: And he will make thy righteousness to go forth as the light, And thy justice as the noonday.

7.web: Rest in Yahweh, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.
7.asv: Rest in Jehovah, and wait patiently for him: Fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, Because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.

8.web: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret, it leads only to evildoing.
8.asv: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: Fret not thyself, it tendeth only to evil-doing.

9.web: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for Yahweh shall inherit the land.
9.asv: For evil-doers shall be cut off; But those that wait for Jehovah, they shall inherit the land.

10.web: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.
10.asv: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: Yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and he shall not be.

11.web: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
11.asv: But the meek shall inherit the land, And shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

12.web: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.
12.asv: The wicked plotteth against the just, And gnasheth upon him with his teeth.

13.web: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.
13.asv: The Lord will laugh at him; For he seeth that his day is coming.

14.web: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.
14.asv: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, To cast down the poor and needy, To slay such as are upright in the way.

15.web: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.
15.asv: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, And their bows shall be broken.

16.web: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.
16.asv: Better is a little that the righteous hath Than the abundance of many wicked.

17.web: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but Yahweh upholds the righteous.
17.asv: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken; But Jehovah upholdeth the righteous.

18.web: Yahweh knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.
18.asv: Jehovah knoweth the days of the perfect; And their inheritance shall be for ever.

19.web: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
19.asv: They shall not be put to shame in the time of evil; And in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

20.web: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of Yahweh shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.
20.asv: But the wicked shall perish, And the enemies of Jehovah shall be as the fat of lambs: They shall consume; in smoke shall they consume away.

21.web: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.
21.asv: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again; But the righteous dealeth graciously, and giveth.

22.web: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.
22.asv: For such as are blessed of him shall inherit the land; And they that are cursed of him shall be cut off.

23.web: A man’s goings are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.
23.asv: A man’s goings are established of Jehovah; And he delighteth in his way.

24.web: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.
24.asv: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down; For Jehovah upholdeth him with his hand.

25.web: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.
25.asv: I have been young, and now am old; Yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, Nor his seed begging bread.

26.web: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His seed is blessed.
26.asv: All the day long he dealeth graciously, and lendeth; And his seed is blessed.

27.web: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.
27.asv: Depart from evil, and do good; And dwell for evermore.

28.web: For Yahweh loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.
28.asv: For Jehovah loveth justice, And forsaketh not his saints; They are preserved for ever: But the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

29.web: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.
29.asv: The righteous shall inherit the land, And dwell therein for ever.

30.web: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.
30.asv: The mouth of the righteous talketh of wisdom, And his tongue speaketh justice.

31.web: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.
31.asv: The law of his God is in his heart; None of his steps shall slide.

32.web: The wicked watches the righteous, and seeks to kill him.
32.asv: The wicked watcheth the righteous, And seeketh to slay him.

33.web: Yahweh will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
33.asv: Jehovah will not leave him in his hand, Nor condemn him when he is judged.

34.web: Wait for Yahweh, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.
34.asv: Wait for Jehovah, and keep his way, And he will exalt thee to inherit the land: When the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.

35.web: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
35.asv: I have seen the wicked in great power, And spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.

36.web: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
36.asv: But one passed by, and, lo, he was not: Yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.

37.web: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.
37.asv: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright; For there is ahappyend to the man of peace.

38.web: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.
38.asv: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together: The end of the wicked shall be cut off.

39.web: But the salvation of the righteous is from Yahweh. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
39.asv: But the salvation of the righteous is of Jehovah: He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.

40.web: Yahweh helps them, and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked, and saves them, Because they have taken refuge in him.
40.asv: And Jehovah helpeth them, and rescueth them: He rescueth them from the wicked, and saveth them, Because they have taken refuge in him.
